privacy: Identifier-free aggregate metrics only; study-level OOF rows remain external.

protocol.prediction_rule: Each fold-best checkpoint predicts only its untouched gold fold.

prevalence_only_reference.interpretation: The imaging model improves calibration losses only slightly over gold-set prevalence predictions.

score_alignment_diagnostic.use: Diagnostic only; fold identity is unavailable for competition test data.
score_alignment_diagnostic.interpretation: Most of the gap between mean fold AUC and raw pooled AUC comes from checkpoint score-scale drift, but discrimination remains far below the competitive target.

decisions: Do not spend GPU credit repeating the current recipe.
Treat Contusion, Fracture, and Medial Meniscus as first-order modeling failures.
Build the first valid five-checkpoint Kaggle inference submission before larger experiments.
Require cheap fixed-fold evidence before promoting any change to five-fold training.
